description: This PHP source file defines the MigrationHelper class, which provides methods for managing database migration logs, including starting and finishing migration entries. It interacts with database schemas and logs migration versions and timestamps.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing database migration logs, including starting and finishing migration records, with support for connecting to the database and schema management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes MigrationHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the active database connection, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Provides access to the SchemaHelper instance, creating it if needed.

methods.name: logMigrationStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a migration process with a specific version, creating necessary database schema if absent.

methods.name: logMigrationFinished
methods.description: Marks a migration as finished by updating its finish timestamp based on the migration version.
